gaps.description: BMI constructs and numerical lipid units are transported despite different fasting, specimen and laboratory protocols versus target venous EDTA immediate CardioChek Plus; no calibrated assay bridge is available. A38.67 unit conversion is not assay equivalence.
gaps.consequence: The requested analysis remains dependent on this unverified modeling/transport assumption.

gaps.description: Source age and health/complete-case restrictions differ; target excludes none of pregnancy, HIV, diabetes or fasting status by inference. Effects of this selection difference are absorbed into an unverified transport assumption.
gaps.consequence: The requested analysis remains dependent on this unverified modeling/transport assumption.

gaps.description: Pooled source rural Spearman dependence is applied within each sex; pooled Agongo lipid CVs are applied within each sex. Source conditioning does not identify the requested age/sex/BMI-conditioned law.
gaps.consequence: The requested analysis remains dependent on this unverified modeling/transport assumption.

gaps.description: Unadjusted rank/marginal evidence is only a component of adjusted raw-scale analyses. The full model supplies the adjustment relationships; no unadjusted statistic is relabelled as an adjusted slope or residual correlation.
gaps.consequence: The requested analysis remains dependent on this unverified modeling/transport assumption.

gaps.description: Geometric scales, arithmetic mean/SD ratios and Spearman ranks play distinct roles. Gaussian-copula and lognormal identities are model-based derivations, not changes to source definitions. Target OLS uses raw lipids and BMI, conversion38.67 and per5 BMI reporting.
gaps.consequence: The requested analysis remains dependent on this unverified modeling/transport assumption.

gaps.description: Within each sex the latent age/BMI/TC/HDL vector is multivariate Gaussian with the declared unit variances and matrix. Rural Spearman entries map by2*sin(pi*r_s/6) under a continuous Gaussian copula. Homogeneous sex dependence and pooled-to-within-sex transfer are assumptions, not reported source facts.
gaps.consequence: The requested analysis remains dependent on this unverified modeling/transport assumption.

gaps.description: Within-study summaries are dependent; no participant-level overlap audit is asserted. Seeds vary individuals only; structure, selection, transport and parameter uncertainty are uncalibrated and fixed.
gaps.consequence: The requested analysis remains dependent on this unverified modeling/transport assumption.
